justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/TypeReferenceAdjustment.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/TypeReferenceAdjustmentTest.java. TypeReferenceClassVisitor is instantiated only once inside TypeReferenceAdjustment.wrap() (line 118) and rg found no other references to TypeReferenceClassVisitor anywhere in the repository. The only repo-level usage is through the outer TypeReferenceAdjustment API in its dedicated test class, so there is no evidence of strong fan-in; despite many outgoing ASM/Byte Buddy visitor calls, this looks like a local helper rather than a dependency hub.
